name: Lack Of Chi
text: Give to the Danny Rand player. When Revealed: Move all chi counters from your identity to this card. Forced Interrupt: When you would place a chi counter on Iron Fist, place it here instead. If there are at least 4 chi counters here, discard this card.

name: Davos
text: When Revealed: Find and tuck the 3 Crane Daughter minions under here. Forced Interrupt: When Davos would take any amount of damage, shuffle a tucked Crane Daughter from under Davos into the encounter deck instead. (Iron Fist's nemesis minion.)

name: Crane Daughter
text:
Vulnerable. When Defeated: Shuffle Crane Daughter into the encounter deck.
[star] Boost: After this activation, tuck this card under Davos.

name: Steel Serpent
text: Forced Interrupt: When Davos attacks, discard a Crane Daughter tucked under him or defeat a Crane Daughter in play → Davos gets +3 ATK for this attack.
